import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class C_4_Variant1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long a = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long b = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        
        List<Long> divisors = new ArrayList<>();
        long diff = Math.abs(a - b);
        long sqrtDiff = (long) Math.sqrt(diff);
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= sqrtDiff; i++) {
            if (diff % i == 0) {
                divisors.add(i);
                divisors.add(diff / i);
            }
        }
        
        long minLcm = lcm(a, b);
        long bestK = 0;
        
        for (long d : divisors) {
            long p = d - Math.min(a, b) % d;
            long newLcm = lcm(a + p, b + p);
            if (newLcm < minLcm) {
                minLcm = newLcm;
                bestK = p;
            } else if (newLcm == minLcm) {
                bestK = Math.min(bestK, p);
            }
        }
        
        pw.println(bestK);
        pw.close();
    }
    
    static long gcd(long p, long q) {
        while (q != 0) {
            long temp = q;
            q = p % q;
            p = temp;
        }
        return p;
    }
    
    static long lcm(long p, long q) {
        return p / gcd(p, q) * q;
    }
}
